note: Client verdict on the baseline: NOT VERY PLAYABLE. That is a structural diagnosis, not a polish note, so a tenth law was added to the standard — L10 THE CORE LOOP — and a seventh piece to build it. The mechanic: a detector firing now opens a timed OUTBREAK, drawn where it happened and named in plain words, which the player must answer with the right institution before the fuse runs out. Right answer resolves it visibly; wrong answer explains why; expiry does real damage. A piece cannot be marked won while L10 scores below 8.

pieces.name: PLAY — the outbreak loop
pieces.judged: Law 10 the core loop: a decision every few seconds, a knowable right answer, immediate located consequence, real answerable time pressure, and mastery that accumulates

pieces.name: CHAPTERS — the teaching sequence
pieces.judged: Law 1 one idea at a time, Law 2 play first name second, Law 6 run it again and see, Law 8 no dead time, Law 9 the sandbox is the reward

pieces.judged: Law 3 the causal beat is visible, Law 7 mobile legibility at 390px, can a stranger read the field in three seconds
